title: Morning Brief — Saturday, 12 September 2026
description: Today: OpenAI, Google and Microsoft ramp up AI infrastructure spending while Anthropic discloses disrupted security threats; Australia mourns Blanche d'Alpuget and reacts to sliding PISA results; Queensland's credit rating is downgraded; and Gold Coast commuters face new rail closures from 19 September. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
